Job Position: Public Health Officer

Job Summary


	Elkris Group is seeking a qualified, passionate, and dedicated Public Health Officer to join our growing team. We are committed to improving health outcomes through quality healthcare services, health education, disease prevention, and community-based health initiatives.
	We are looking for a proactive professional who is passionate about public health, community engagement, and promoting healthier lifestyles.
	The Public Health Officer will be responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring public health programs, promoting health awareness, conducting community outreach activities, and supporting disease prevention and health promotion initiatives.
	The successful candidate will work closely with healthcare professionals, community stakeholders, and relevant departments to improve public health awareness and service delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan and implement public health programs and community health initiatives.
	Conduct health education, awareness campaigns, and community outreach activities.
	Promote disease prevention, healthy lifestyles, and general wellness.
	Identify public health challenges within target communities and recommend appropriate interventions.
	Collect, analyze, and interpret public health data to support decision-making.
	Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of public health programs.
	Collaborate with healthcare professionals, government agencies, NGOs, and community leaders.
	Prepare accurate reports on public health activities, findings, and program outcomes.
	Support health screenings, vaccination awareness, and other preventive healthcare initiatives where applicable.
	Ensure compliance with relevant public health regulations, ethical standards, and organizational policies.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Successful implementation of public health programs.
	Number of community outreach and health awareness activities conducted.
	Level of community participation and engagement.
	Effectiveness of health education and disease prevention initiatives.
	Accuracy and timeliness of public health reports.
	Achievement of assigned public health program targets.
	Compliance with public health standards and organizational policies.


Requirements and Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Public Health, Community Health, Environmental Health, Health Education, or a related discipline.
	2&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in public health, community health, or health promotion.

	Strong knowledge of public health principles, disease prevention, and health promotion strategies.
	Excellent communication, presentation, and community engagement skills.
	Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret health-related data.
	Strong organizational, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant reporting tools.
	Professional certification or registration with a relevant regulatory body, where applicable, is an added advantage.


What We Offer


	Competitive remuneration.
	Opportunity to contribute to meaningful healthcare initiatives.
	Professional growth and career development.
	A collaborative and purpose-driven work environment.

title: Job Openings at HR Aid Consults
content:
At HR Aid, we provide consulting services in the area of Human Resource Management. Our focus is in helping our clients hire, engage and retain the best talent. We offer professional services in Talent Recruitment and Selection, HR Policy Development, Compensation & Benefits Structure Development, Performance Management and HR Advisory.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Project Engineer (Project Management)

Job Location: Ago Palace Way Okota, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Requirements / Skills
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Bachelor’s degree in any field.
	Ability to use Microsoft projects and other project management tools.
	Ability to do engineering drawings and site management.
	Use of PowerPoint and other Microsoft office tools.


Salary
N250,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 27th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

 

 

2.) HR Associate

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Requirements


	Must be smart and have extensive HR Generalist experience.
	Good knowledge of performance management
	Good knowledge of payroll
	Knowledge of labor laws and standard HR practices.
	Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
	Must have excellent written & verbal skills.
	Proximity to Lekki is an advantage.
	Females are highly encouraged to apply.
	Please note that resumption is immediate.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 26th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

 

 

3.) Business Development Officer (Female)

Job Location: Ago Palace Way - Okota, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Job Summary


	Our client is looking to hire a BDO to join their team.
	The Business Development Officer (BDO) is responsible for driving business growth by identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic client relationships, preparing winning proposals, and achieving sales targets across the company’s service portfolio.
	The role requires a proactive, target-driven professional with experience in B2B sales, preferably within HSE consulting, engineering services, industrial inspection, certification, environmental services, or energy management.


Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities across the Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, FMCG, Power, Construction, Telecommunications, and Government sectors.
	Develop and implement annual and quarterly business development plans.
	Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers.
	Generate qualified leads through networking, cold outreach, referrals, digital platforms, and industry events.
	Maintain a robust sales pipeline using the company’s CRM.


Sales & Revenue Generation:


	Achieve monthly and annual revenue targets.
	Convert enquiries into profitable contracts.
	Lead negotiations until contract award.
	Coordinate bid submissions and tender responses.


Proposal Development:


	Prepare technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with technical teams.
	Develop capability statements and company presentations.
	Ensure timely submission of bids and RFQs.


Client Relationship Management:


	Conduct regular client visits.
	Maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
	Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities.
	Resolve client concerns promptly.


Market Intelligence:


	Monitor competitors.
	Identify new market opportunities.
	Track government and private sector procurement opportunities.


Reporting:


	Weekly sales reports.
	Monthly pipeline reports.
	Tender tracker.
	Revenue forecast.
	Client engagement reports.


Salary
N300,000 gross monthly.

Application Closing Date: 30th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Bridgemead Limited is a holistic and innovative business consultancy that believes in connecting businesses with the right individuals. We take pride in not just connecting clients to skilled talent but also ensuring we provide personalised solutions to all Human Resource challenges.

At Bridgemead, we offer professional and unique Human Resources solutions to facilitate specific business requirements, enabling you focus solely on your business. We are a fully outsourced platform for Small Medium Enterprises (SME&rsquo;s) and our services span the full spectrum of all HR relayed business priorities. All our experts are CIPM, CIPD, SPHRI qualified with vast experience of real &ndash; life business processes.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Business &amp; Operations Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (On-site)
Reporting Line: Managing Director
Industry: Consulting &amp; Business Advisory

Job Summary


	Bridgemead Advisory is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and commercially aware Business &amp; Operations Manager with prior experience working in a consulting and advisory firm to oversee the firm&#39;s internal operations, business administration, and organisational effectiveness.
	The ideal candidate must understand the operational dynamics of a consulting or professional services business, including coordinating client engagements, managing internal resources, strengthening business processes, supporting financial and administrative functions, and ensuring efficient service delivery.
	Working closely with the Managing Director and Lead Consultants, the successful candidate will translate business priorities into effective operational systems, processes, and execution plans. The individual will play a critical role in strengthening Bridgemead&#39;s operational infrastructure, improving organisational efficiency, and building the systems required to support sustainable growth.
	This role requires a hands-on professional who combines operational leadership, administrative discipline, people management, and commercial awareness within a consulting and advisory environment.


Key Responsibilities
Business Operations &amp; Process Management:


	Oversee the firm&#39;s day-to-day operations and coordinate activities across consulting, business development, finance, and administration.
	Design, implement, document, and continuously improve workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), internal controls, and operational processes.
	Monitor operational KPIs, identify inefficiencies, and implement process improvements that enhance productivity and service delivery.
	Support the Managing Director in translating strategic priorities into operational plans, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
	Establish systems that promote accountability, efficiency, and consistency across the firm&#39;s internal operations.


Financial, Resource &amp; Commercial Management:


	Support budgeting, financial planning, expense monitoring, and cost management in collaboration with Finance.
	Track project resourcing, billable utilisation, engagement budgets, invoicing, cash flow, and vendor payments.
	Monitor operational expenditure and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilisation.
	Prepare periodic operational and financial reports to support management decision-making.
	Support the effective administration of consulting engagements, including resource allocation, project tracking, and commercial documentation.


People Operations &amp; Administration:


	Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, performance reviews, staff engagement, employee records, contracts, and HR documentation.
	Support the development and implementation of HR policies, procedures, and workplace practices in line with applicable Nigerian labour requirements.
	Oversee office administration, procurement, supplies, facilities, and vendor relationships.
	Promote a structured, accountable, and performance-oriented work environment.
	Ensure the effective management of administrative resources and the smooth coordination of internal activities.


Systems, Technology &amp; Performance Reporting:


	Manage and optimise the firm&#39;s project management, CRM, finance, reporting, and collaboration systems.
	Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate access controls across operational platforms.
	Develop dashboards and reports that provide leadership with visibility into operational performance, resource utilisation, and engagement delivery.
	Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and leverage digital tools to improve productivity.
	Promote the effective use of technology to strengthen coordination, reporting, and organisational efficiency.


Governance, Compliance &amp; Risk Management:


	Coordinate compliance with applicable regulatory, statutory, and contractual obligations.
	Maintain corporate records, licences, insurance documentation, statutory filings, and other essential business documents.
	Support the Managing Director in identifying and managing operational, financial, and reputational risks.
	Coordinate with external legal, tax, audit, and other professional advisers as required.
	Maintain appropriate internal controls and documentation to support sound governance and business continuity.


Client Engagement &amp; Consulting Delivery Support:


	Coordinate the operational requirements of consulting and advisory engagements, including project setup, scheduling, resource allocation, and progress tracking.
	Facilitate internal coordination between consultants, management, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure effective client delivery.
	Coordinate logistics for client meetings, executive engagements, workshops, roundtables, and corporate events.
	Support the preparation and organisation of client-facing presentations, proposals, reports, and engagement documentation.
	Monitor engagement timelines and operational requirements to ensure consultants have the resources and support needed to deliver high-quality work.
	Identify opportunities to improve the firm&#39;s client engagement processes and overall service delivery experience.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Economics, Finance, or a related discipline.
	A Master&#39;s degree or MBA is an advantage.


Professional Experience:


	4&ndash;5 years of progressive experience in business operations, operations management, practice management, business administration, or a related operational leadership role.
	Prior experience working in a consulting, management advisory, business advisory, accounting, or professional services firm is a key requirement.
	Demonstrated understanding of the operational structure and delivery requirements of a consulting or advisory business.
	Experience coordinating multiple business functions, managing operational processes, and supporting senior leadership.
	Demonstrated experience in budgeting, expense monitoring, vendor management, resource allocation, and operational reporting.
	Practical experience supporting consulting projects, client engagements, business processes, or professional services delivery.
	Working knowledge of HR administration, office management, and applicable Nigerian labour and regulatory requirements.


Technical Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Proficiency in project management, CRM, reporting, and collaboration tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, HubSpot, Notion, and Microsoft or Google Workspace.
	Ability to develop operational reports, dashboards, and performance tracking systems.
	Familiarity with workflow automation, digital tools, and process optimisation is an advantage.
	Strong organisational, multitasking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior leadership and professional stakeholders.
	High levels of discretion, integrity, accountability, and professionalism when handling confidential business information.
	Candidate suitability: Candidates with general administrative or operations experience but no prior exposure to a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment may not be suitable for this position.


Core Competencies:


	Operational Excellence | Consulting Operations | Financial &amp; Commercial Acumen | Process Improvement | People &amp; Resource Management | Technology &amp; Systems Fluency | Governance &amp; Compliance | Problem Solving | Stakeholder Management | Performance Reporting


What Success Looks Like:


	The successful candidate will establish and maintain efficient operational systems, improve coordination across the firm&#39;s functions, strengthen internal controls, and ensure that the Managing Director and consulting teams have the operational support required to deliver high-quality client engagements.
	Ultimately, the individual will contribute to Bridgemead Advisory&#39;s organisational effectiveness, operational discipline, client service quality, and capacity for sustainable growth.


Salary
N400,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: career.bridgemeadnghr@gmail.com using &quot;Business and Operations Manager&quot; as the subject of the email.",
